selected.captureInstructions: First play original prefab with its Animator so Projectile/Explosion activation curves are visible. Then isolate Explosion only in a review clone, preserving its complete descendant hierarchy, materials and authored particle curves. Do not count inactive alternate Projectile branches as simultaneous live cost.
selected.reusePlan: 원래 계층·메시·문양·재생곡선을 함께 재사용. 실제 타격·발동 신호 연결 시 기존 Charge/Projectile/Explosion 예시 타임라인과 게임 판정을 분리.
limitations: Static serialization audit only; runtime live particleCount and peak overdraw unmeasured.
